_source: Written only from the project's own documentation of Apache Commons Imaging 1.0-alpha2 (git tag commons-imaging-1.0-alpha2, commit a2d77b8): the package-info javadoc descriptions under src/main/java, the site pages src/site/xdoc/index.xml, formatsupport.xml and whyimaging.xml, and README.md; package names, class names and file names were removed.
base: The main package of Apache Commons Imaging, a pure-Java library that reads and writes a variety of image formats, including fast parsing of image info (size, color space, ICC profile, etc.) and metadata. It offers a simple, clean interface where most operations are a single method call, presents image info and metadata in a format-neutral manner, and can guess an image's format by examining its magic numbers (header info).
color: Color spaces and conversions between them, such as CIE-L*CH, CIE-L*ab, CIE-L*uv, CMY, CMYK, HSL, HSV, Hunter-Lab, RGB, XYZ and Yxy.
common: Provides utility classes that are employed across multiple image formats and sub-packages, including LZW compression, ITU-T T.4 and T.6 compression, and sources from which data may be read (files, byte arrays or input streams).
bmp: The BMP image format: mostly complete reading and writing of bitmaps, though some cursors, icons and OS/2 bitmaps may not be read.
dcx: The DCX image format: reading and writing of multi-page PCX/DCX images, including short DCX tables.
gif: The GIF image format: reading and writing of versions 87a and 89a, including reading all of the images contained in an animated GIF (timing/loop info is ignored).
icns: The ICNS image format: reading and writing of MacOS X icons in all formats and sizes except JPEG2000 icons.
ico: The ICO/CUR image formats: reading 1/4/8/16/24/32 bpp icon and cursor files, including Windows Vista icons with embedded PNGs, with mostly complete writing.
jpeg: The JPEG image format: reads simple baseline sequential JPEG images and can read image info, metadata and extract ICC profiles, with a decoder, segments, and Exif, IPTC and XMP metadata support (reading and writing EXIF and XMP into existing JPEG/JFIF files without modifying image data).
pcx: The PCX image format: reading and writing of PCX images in various plane and bit-depth combinations, including the undocumented uncompressed PCX format.
png: The PNG image format: reading and writing supported through version 1.2 (ISO/IEC 15948:2003), with PNG chunks, scan-line filters and transparency filters.
pnm: The PNM image format family (PNM/PGM/PBM/PPM/PAM portable pixmaps): complete reading, and writing with PAM only in RGB_ALPHA format.
psd: The PSD (Photoshop) image format: basic read-only support of the first layer and some image metadata, with PSD data readers and data parsers.
rgbe: The Radiance HDR (RGBE) image format: basic read-only support.
tiff: Provides classes and methods for reading and writing Tagged Image File Format (TIFF) files, which are widely used in applications for which supplemental metadata is added to images in the form of tags. It includes TIFF constants, field types, tag definitions, data readers, writers and photometric interpreters (the intended interpretation of the image pixel data), and supports LZW, CCITT Group 3/Group 4 and Packbits compression.
wbmp: The Wireless Application Protocol Bitmap Format (WBMP) image format: complete support for reading and writing type 0 bitmaps.
xbm: The X BitMap image format: complete reading and writing support.
xpm: The X PixMap image format: reading and writing of XPM version 3, reading all color formats including symbolic color names.
icc: ICC color profile: extracting and (simply) parsing embedded ICC profiles, which are applied by default to convert read images to sRGB.
internal: Internal utility classes. These classes must not be used by users.
palette: Color quantization and palette manipulation tools.
